Liam (Partnerships): Heads up01: HelixAI reached out re: listing their model + edge delivery bundle in our marketplace. They want permission to redistribute quantized artifacts to SIs.
Rina (Legal): Do we have the upstream license link? Redistribution permissions are the gating factor.
Liam (Partnerships): Repo: https://models.helix.ai/helix-7b-mix. License file in repo looks custom-notice + "NonCommercial-Helix" clause.
Rina (Legal): Oof. "NonCommercial" language typically prohibits commercial redistribution. We can't permit partner redistribution unless Helix grants a commercial sublicense.
Diego (Eng-ML): From infra side, alternative is hosted-only plus a marketplace SKU that bundles accelerator discounts for calls routed from partner infra. Partner still sells hardware but calls our hosted endpoint.
Tess (Product): Hosted-only SKU is workable. We need to define: SKU name, billing meter (tokens vs requests), and an API routing label so partner customers use discounted endpoints.
Zoe (Compliance): Also check data residency: partner's edge customers may require local hosting. If redistribution blocked, on-prem is a blocker for some customers. Need a fallback compliance plan.
Marcus (Partner Ops): Helix timeline: they want marketplace tile + co-marketing week of 2025-12-08. They asked if we can support an "edge bundle" listing.
Rina (Legal): Action: ask Helix for a commercial redistribution grant (template I can provide). If they can't, we draft a hosted-bundle agreement plus messaging that partner does not distribute weights.
Liam (Partnerships): I pinged Helix asking for chain-of-title and whether there's any third-party components in their checkpoints. Waiting reply.
Diego (Eng-ML): Technical ask: if we go hosted-bundle, we should produce a fingerprint manifest so outputs can be audited. Suggest adding to SOW: `model_fingerprint_sha256`, `quantize_recipe_id`, and a small verification script. Example snippet I can provide.
Tess (Product): Good. Also require version pinning in the agreement: `model_spec: helix-7b-mix@2025-11-01` and a documented fallback plan `fallback_route: helix-3b@stable`.
Rina (Legal): I'll draft two short clauses: (A) commercial redistribution grant template; (B) hosted-bundle licensing terms with attribution, usage telemetry sharing, and naming restrictions (no renaming the model).
Zoe (Compliance): Telemetry note: we need to surface sample logs for compliance (PII scrubbed). Partner must agree to our log redaction policy.
Marcus (Partner Ops): Can we ask Helix to sign the commercial grant within 10 business days? If no, we lock on hosted-only. I'll flag the marketplace date to our launch ops.
Liam (Partnerships): @Rina please share the grant template. @Diego can you prepare the verification script + a short README we can attach to the marketplace tile?
Diego (Eng-ML): Will do. Verification will be a tiny python script that compares `manifest.recipe_sha256` to our published value and runs a deterministic tokenization sanity check.
Rina (Legal): Drafts uploaded: "helix_commercial_grant_draft.docx" and "hosted_bundle_terms_redline.docx". Please review and comment by Thu EOD.
Tess (Product): For marketplace tile copy: short blurb + 3 bullets. Example: "Helix-7B Mix via Redwood12: high-quality open mix served with enterprise SLAs." Need partner quote and logo by next Wed.
Marcus (Partner Ops): Calendar-bot, please schedule a 45-min partner intake call with Helix legal + product next Mon 9AM PT.
calendar-bot: Event created: "HelixAI x Redwood intake: legal & product" 12Mon 2025-10-27 09:00 PT. Guests: Liam, Rina, Tess, Diego, Marcus, Helix legal, Helix product.
Liam (Partnerships): If Helix agrees to grant redistribution on a per-country basis we could allow SI distribution only in approved territories. @Rina can we draft territory-limited grant language?
Rina (Legal): Yes. Will add an optional schedule of territories and export-control warranty. Also include a clause for revocation if downstream license terms are violated.
Zoe (Compliance): And include a checklist for partner-provided artifacts: license text, third-party dependencies, export class confirmation, and a notarized sign-off for prohibited countries.
Diego (Eng-ML): One more technical note: redistributed quantized weights will need a recommended runtime config. Add a `runtime_constraints` section to the manifest (min_cuda_compute, quant_backend).
Tess (Product): Agreed. We'll bake those into the marketplace product spec so SIs know supported HW and expected perf.
Marcus (Partner Ops): I'll collate all asks and send Helix a single intake packet tonight. Timeline: legal signoff by 2025-11-10 or we pivot to hosted-only.
Liam (Partnerships): Thanks team. Outcome options: (1) Helix grants commercial redistribution in agreed territories -> enable edge SKU + SI redistribution; (2) No grant -> hosted-bundle only + co-marketing. We'll update the marketplace launch plan once Helix replies. :thumbsup:
